subject: Re: Isolation evidence packet & threat summation — Acme Financial RFI
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@acmefinancial.com>
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: security-questions@acmefinancial.com
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: RFI — detailed isolation evidence and threat summary request

Diego,

Thanks for taking this on. For our upcoming architectural review we need a concise evidence packet that covers: a network diagram (annotated with zones and egress controls), a short isolation narrative describing tenant separation and sidecar/mesh considerations, and a one-page threat-model summary that calls out likely attack paths and mitigations specific to inference (KV cache, sidecar egress, model variant fallback).

Deliverables we need by COB PST today if possible:
- Annotated network diagram (SVG preferred)
- Isolation evidence packet (PDF) — configuration notes, service mappings, ACL examples
- One-page threat-model summary + an editable spreadsheet of the enumerated paths

We may surface a few follow-ups to the compliance committee; please include any links to runtime tracing or audit-log evidence that can be redacted.

Liam
Security Architect
Acme Financial

--
Note: we may want the packet to match our internal control catalog (IAC-3, NET-2) — happy to sync if anything is ambiguous.

Liam — thanks, received. We're assembling a concise evidence packet and can get an initial drop by EOD PST.

Quick plan:
- Vanessa will produce the annotated network diagram and include per-zone egress controls.
- Marissa will craft the PDF evidence packet (controls, config snippets, ACL examples).
- Karthik will prepare the one-page threat-model summary and the spreadsheet of enumerated attack paths.

We will include links to audit logs/traces (redacted) and a short appendix describing runtime KV cache controls and fallback-model routing. If you have a preference for the namespace referenced in controls (IAC-3 vs. NET-2), call it out and we'll align.

Delivering: 2026-11-22 16:30 PST (target)
If anything moves earlier please ping me.

— Diego

Date: 2026-11-22T10:10:00-08:00
Subject: ACME RFI — quick internal coordination (deliverables + links)

Team — Liam wants a compact evidence packet by EOD PST. I created a shared folder and stubbed an index doc: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme_RFI/Isolation_Evidence_Packet (view-only for now).

Action items:
- Vanessa: annotated network diagram (SVG). Please call out: control plane vs. inference plane, tenant ingress points, KV cache boundaries, sidecar egress, and explicit egress proxies/bastion notes. Add per-zone firewall rule examples in a small table on the diagram.
- Marissa: PDF evidence packet. Include snippets: iptables/sg examples, VPC peering statements, example HA failover for dedicated pools, and a short paragraph on rollback/canary behavior for model rollouts.
- Karthik: threat-model one-pager and spreadsheet. Enumerate 6–8 plausible attack paths (e.g., cached KV leakage, model-variant downgrade path, data-exfil via misrouted sidecar) and map mitigations (RBAC, mTLS, egress filtering, KV encryption-at-rest).

Please drop final artifacts to the folder and ping me with any blockers. I will deliver to Liam and cc legal/compliance for their records.

Diego

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-22T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: ACME RFI — quick internal coordination (deliverables + links)

Diego — thanks. Dropping initial artifacts into the folder now. Attached: inference-network-diagram-annotated.svg (SVG, annotated layers) and a small CSV with zone-firewall-examples.

Notes included on the diagram (summary):
- Control plane is isolated to a management VPC with strict peering only to inference VPCs; all control plane egress is via a dedicated egress proxy (no direct internet egress).
- Inference plane has tenant-routing at the sidecar boundary; each tenant's traffic is pinned to tenant-specific KV namespaces and separate S3 prefixes.
- KV cache: encrypted at rest, in-memory eviction policy documented; cache sharding prevents cross-tenant key overlap.
- Fallback model variants are served from an immutable model store; routing policies only allow fallback to compatible variants with audited policy decisions recorded in the decision log.

Attachment stubs: inference-network-diagram-annotated.svg, zone-firewall-examples.csv

Vanessa
Security Architect, Platform
Redwood Inference

Date: 2026-11-22T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Isolation evidence packet & threat summation — delivery (Acme Financial RFI)

Liam / Acme security team — attaching the initial evidence packet for your review. Below is a short index and what we included so you can route to the committee quickly.

Attachments (zip of the three files listed below):
- isolation-evidence-packet-v1.pdf — controls, config snippets, proof notes (redacted traces), and a short narrative on tenant separation at runtime.
- inference-network-diagram-annotated.svg — vector diagram with annotated zones, egress proxies, and per-zone rule examples.
- threat-model-summary-v2.xlsx — one-sheet summary + enumerated attack paths with mapped mitigations and confidence scoring.

Executive summary (2 bullets):
- Tenant separation is enforced at the sidecar boundary and reinforced with namespace-scoped KV stores, encrypted caches, and strict route isolation; control plane access is limited to a management VPC with controlled peering.
- The top residual risks are (1) misconfiguration of egress ACLs, (2) application-level leakage from model outputs under crafted prompts, and (3) potential KV key provenance gaps during high-concurrency eviction. Each is addressed with concrete mitigations in the packet (egress proxy hardening, output filters + content classifiers, KV sharding + audit hooks).

Callouts for reviewers:
- We included redacted audit-log excerpts demonstrating decision logging for model-fallback events — those are evidence-level artifacts but can be expanded if the committee needs full logs under NDA.
- The diagram includes an appendix of example firewall rules (SG/IPTables) and a sample canary rollback checklist for model rollouts.

Next steps:
- Please review and share any gaps by 2026-11-24 so we can produce expanded artifacts if needed (full logs, extra diagram views, or control test outputs).
- If the committee wants a short walkthrough, Vanessa and I can join a 30-minute call early next week to walk through the diagram and threat mapping.

Thanks — looking forward to feedback.

— Diego
Principal Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

Attachments: isolation-evidence-packet-v1.pdf, inference-network-diagram-annotated.svg, threat-model-summary-v2.xlsx
